Here are several title options for your epic character portrait:

**"The Sentinel's Oath"**

Alternative titles:
- "Last Knight of Valorh"
- "The Bladeguard"
- "Herald of the Forgotten Realm"
- "Keeper of the eternal Vigil"
- "The Iron Resolve"
- "Warden's edge"
- "Champion of the First Light"

"Dawn's Edge"could also work for something shorter and more poetic!
